Each section has pages (title up to 28 chars, body up to 260 chars). src/ui/tutorial.ts shows a section once per player (flags tut_<id>), a '?' button reopens it, and Guides lists them all. Keep to letters, digits and . , : ! ? - + x ( ) because the pixel font has no apostrophe or semicolon.

pages.title: Realms and levels
pages.body: Each strip is a realm full of levels. Tap a lit level to play it. Clear a level to unlock the next one. The Daily Mash is a fresh level every day with its own leaderboard.

pages.title: Stars and bosses
pages.body: Earn up to 3 stars per level for a high score and spare shots. Boss levels can drop relics, powerful weapons you keep. Bonus realms at the end have tougher forts.

pages.title: Fill your slots
pages.body: Tap a weapon to fill the next slot. Weapons fire in slot order, one per shot. Tap a filled slot to clear it. A level gives you a limited number of shots, so plan the order.

pages.title: Limits and extras
pages.body: You can carry only one Legendary weapon at a time. Artifacts and items on the right are optional boosts. Tap Fling when you are ready.

pages.title: Aim and fling
pages.body: Press and drag back from the sling to aim, then let go to fling. The dotted line shows where the shot will go. Pull farther for more power.

pages.title: Ability and view
pages.body: While the weapon flies, tap the ability button or press Space. Use the zoom button or the mouse wheel to look over the whole fort.

pages.title: Win the level
pages.body: Defeat every monster before your shots run out. Out of shots? You may watch an ad for 2 more shots that hit 25 percent harder. A high score and spare shots earn up to 3 stars.

pages.title: Step 1: fling
pages.body: Drag back from the sling and let go. The weapon flies. Its ability button sits at the bottom of the screen and shows the ability name, for example Whirl.

pages.title: Step 2: tap in flight
pages.body: While the weapon is in the air, tap the ability button or press Space. Do it before it hits, near the fort, for the best effect.

pages.title: Button, impact, both
pages.body: Button: you choose the moment. Both: tap it, or it fires on its first hit. Legendary and Epic abilities have limited charges, so use them on purpose.

pages.title: Examples
pages.body: Whirl spins the blade through blocks. Volley splits the staff into many bolts. Nuke makes the blast tube explode. Try each one on a quiet level to learn its timing.

pages.title: Swords fall short
pages.body: The Militia Blade is heavy and drops early, so it cannot reach the far archers on this level. Pulling harder will not help because the pull is capped.

pages.title: Swap in arrows
pages.body: On the loadout screen tap a filled slot to clear it, then pick an arrow such as the Steersong Arrow (a chest on level 3 holds it) or the floaty Ashwood Staff. They fall slower, so they fly farther. Keep the blade for near targets.

pages.title: Same speed, different pull
pages.body: Every weapon leaves the sling at the same speed for the same pull. What changes is how hard gravity pulls it down once it is in the air.

pages.title: Light weapons go far
pages.body: The Boomerang, Staff and Scepter have low gravity, so they float farther and flatter. Choose them for forts that are far away.

pages.title: Heavy weapons drop
pages.body: The Cleaver has high gravity and drops sooner, so it smashes near or tall targets. Legendary weapons also feel a little air drag as they fly.

pages.title: Aiming tip
pages.body: Aim higher for more distance. Pull is capped, so when a fort is out of reach, switch to a lighter weapon instead of pulling harder.

pages.title: Base damage
pages.body: The number on a weapon card is its base damage. Faster impacts hit harder, and forge levels add extra damage on top.

pages.title: Elements
pages.body: A monster weak to your weapon element takes 1.5x damage. A resistant one takes only 0.6x. Check the monster before you choose.

pages.title: Who is weak to what
pages.body: Goblins are weak to Hellfire. Dark Elves are weak to Radiant and resist Void. Each realm has its own weaknesses, so mix your elements.

pages.title: Combos
pages.body: Land kills within 2 seconds of each other to build a combo. The score multiplier grows with every kill, up to x3.

pages.title: Upgrade damage
pages.body: Open the Forge tab to upgrade a weapon you own. Each level adds 8 percent damage, up to level 5.

pages.title: What it costs
pages.body: The first upgrade costs 50 coins and each level costs 1.6x more. Rare weapons cost 1.5x and Legendary weapons 2.5x as much.

pages.title: Spend wisely
pages.body: Upgrade the weapons you use the most. Replays and lost levels pay fewer coins than a first clear, so coins are worth saving.

pages.title: Create a weapon
pages.body: In the Forge tab tap Create a weapon. Pick a body, a trait, a power and a radiance. Every choice has its own coin price, so builds cost different amounts. Changing a saved build later costs half of its new price.

pages.title: Tabs
pages.body: Spend the coins you earn in levels. The tabs are Weapons, Relics, Artifacts, Items, Forge and Slingshots. Tap a card to read what it does.

pages.title: Getting weapons
pages.body: Most weapons unlock at a level and then cost coins. Boss relics drop from bosses, or can be bought after three losses against that boss.

pages.title: Items and artifacts
pages.body: Items are single use and stack up to 5. Artifacts stay equipped from the loadout screen. On a win you can watch an ad to double the coins.

pages.title: Play other levels
pages.body: Challenges are levels other players built. Top shows the most played, New the latest, and Mine the ones you shared.

pages.title: Rules per challenge
pages.body: The author limits how many shots you get and which weapons you may use. Only weapons you own are shown. Clear it to post a score on its own leaderboard.

pages.title: Share your own
pages.body: Build a fort in Create level, tap Challenge, pick the allowed weapons and share it. Only you can edit or delete your challenge.

pages.title: Place and move
pages.body: Pick a piece and a material, then tap the grid. Pieces snap to the grid cells. With Select, tap to pick one piece or drag across empty space to pick many and move them together.

pages.title: Join and fix
pages.body: Lock joins two blocks, Rope hangs a block, Anchor fixes one in place and Rotate turns a piece a quarter turn. Undo and Clear are at the top.

pages.title: Test and share
pages.body: Test runs real physics on your fort. Play lets you fling at it. Challenge shares it with everyone. Add at least one target first.

pages.title: Head to head
pages.body: See players who are online and invite one to a match on a shared challenge. Each of you plays one full attempt. A clear beats no clear, then the higher score wins.

pages.title: Wagers
pages.body: A wager is optional and uses Arena coins, separate from your campaign coins. You start with 100. A draw gives the stakes back.

pages.title: Invite limits
pages.body: Three rejected invites in a row from the same sender block that sender for one hour. You need a RUN account to join the Arena. Nobody online? Tap Practice match to play the Rival Bot or pass the device to a friend.

pages.title: Three boards
pages.body: Daily is the Daily Mash. This level is the level you last played. Overall adds your best score on every level together.

pages.title: Your name
pages.body: Your own row shows as You. A RUN account shows its account name. Guests can pick a name with the Set name button.
